title: Cross-vendor capability registry for Phase 9 negotiation
description: The vocabulary capability negotiation is conducted in. Kept as DATA (not branches) for the same reason platform/registry/VENDOR-REGISTRY.json is: the table can be audited and extended without editing the resolver. Three-valued by construction - an adapter either OFFERS a capability (measured true), REFUSES it (measured false), or has not measured it. An UNMEASURED capability is never read as offered; that inversion is precisely how DEFECT D1 turned an unrecognized vendor string into a passing cross-vendor gate.

criticality_semantics.REQUIRED: A work unit that names this capability cannot run without it. REFUSED or UNMEASURED -> negotiation verdict REFUSED, the dispatch does not start, and the reason is recorded. This is the spec's 'degrade loudly' (line 10983): loud means a typed refusal carrying the missing capability id, not a silent substitution.
criticality_semantics.DEGRADABLE: The unit can still run, but the run is materially different and the difference must be recorded on the receipt. REFUSED or UNMEASURED -> negotiation verdict DEGRADED with this capability listed under degraded[]. A DEGRADED negotiation is never reported as AGREED.

provenance_note: Every codex-cli entry below is LEDGER-RECORDED by a prior session (the 2026-07-18 cross-vendor rail smoke-test, transcribed into ~/.claude/agents/codex.md) and was NOT re-measured by the Phase 9 build unit. verified_by_this_unit records that distinction so a reader cannot mistake an inherited measurement for a fresh one. The experiment that would settle any of them is re-running the named probe against the current codex-cli build.

capabilities.title: OS-level sandbox actually confines writes
capabilities.degradation_note: Without it, containment is verified POST-HOC by the caller instead of enforced by the runtime, so the WORKDIR must be scoped tightly and the written set checked afterwards. Proceeding is allowed; pretending the sandbox held is not.
capabilities.provenance: C:/Users/Prekzursil/.claude/agents/codex.md:44-50 - '--sandbox workspace-write is INERT on codex-cli 0.144.5 / Windows': -s, -c sandbox_mode and --full-auto all still print 'sandbox: read-only' and the write is auto-rejected 'blocked by policy'.

capabilities.title: Accept the task prompt on stdin
capabilities.degradation_note: Fall back to a runner script that owns the redirect. NOT usable when the dispatch transport detaches the child - see leak L-01.
capabilities.provenance: C:/Users/Prekzursil/.claude/agents/codex.md:33-38 (codex exec accepts '-' with the prompt on stdin) and :52-55 (longrun backgrounds its child, so the redirect never reaches it).

capabilities.title: Accept the task prompt as a FILE path rather than inline text
capabilities.provenance: rules/common/cross-vendor-dispatch.md:34-40 - Windows CreateProcess caps the command line at 32,767 chars; an inline prompt produced payload_len=34472 -> os error 206 and killed both Codex runs that attempted real work. The Bash transport also truncates large heredocs (4,500 B OK / 13,650 B FAIL).

capabilities.title: Write the final result to a caller-named file (a real result channel)
capabilities.provenance: C:/Users/Prekzursil/.claude/agents/codex.md:68-73 - the -o file is the ONLY result channel; the '[codex] ...' progress stream must never be parsed as a result.

capabilities.title: Constrain the final result to a caller-supplied JSON schema
capabilities.degradation_note: Without it the dispatcher must validate the artifact itself; the AND-gate's third limb becomes caller-side. Never skip the limb.
capabilities.provenance: C:/Users/Prekzursil/.claude/agents/codex.md:60-61 - --output-schema is VOIDED when the user MCP inventory is active (codex issue #15451), so --ignore-user-config is mandatory for the typed path.

capabilities.title: Resume the previous thread to repair an invalid result
capabilities.degradation_note: Without resume, a schema-invalid result costs a full re-dispatch instead of a delta prompt.
capabilities.provenance: C:/Users/Prekzursil/.claude/agents/codex.md:75-76 - 'codex exec resume --last' with a delta prompt. UNVERIFIED there: its interaction with --ephemeral is untested; the settling experiment is one resume against an --ephemeral thread.

capabilities.title: The vendor's MCP tool inventory is available during the run
capabilities.degradation_note: MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with schema.typed_output on codex-cli, and the inventory is what blows the Windows arg limit. A unit needing MCP tools cannot also demand a typed output schema on that adapter - negotiation must report the conflict, not pick one silently.

capabilities.title: Can serve as a genuinely cross-vendor independent reviewer
capabilities.provenance: platform/registry/VENDOR-REGISTRY.json + platform/lib/vendor_identity.py - resolved by canonical identity, not by string inequality. Only the 12 identities with establishes_distinctness=true qualify; a hosting plane or placeholder resolves to NOT-COMPUTABLE.

capabilities.title: Can pause and ask the human owner for approval mid-run
capabilities.provenance: work-unit.schema.json owner_approval_required. A non-interactive runtime invoked with --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox structurally cannot pause, so a unit with owner_approval_required=true must not be routed to it.

capabilities.title: The dispatch transport detaches the child process from the caller
capabilities.degradation_note: Enables the >60s longrun path but forfeits stdin inheritance and requires an explicit completion barrier. See leaks L-01 and L-02.
capabilities.provenance: C:/Users/Prekzursil/.claude/AGENTS.md:59-64 (section 4a mandates longrun + run_in_background above 60s) vs rules/common/cross-vendor-dispatch.md:9 (bans run_in_background for a barrier-awaited dispatch).

capabilities.title: Can spawn further subagents of its own
capabilities.degradation_note: A unit whose plan fans out internally must be re-decomposed by the caller when this is absent.
capabilities.provenance: rules/common/cross-vendor-dispatch.md:24-26 - each Codex invocation is single-threaded and fresh-context; there is no cross-thread memory.
